mechanism_narrative: Because WORKPLACES, TRANSIT, and RETAIL_REC are all rising from very depressed levels, continued return-to-city activity should lift shopping trips over the next four weeks. If commuting and station use keep improving, retail visits should edge higher as weekday out-of-home time expands.
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC does not rise versus the last 4 weeks while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both continue to improve week-over-week.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RESIDENTIAL time suppresses discretionary shopping because people stay home longer and shift purchases to fewer, bundled trips. With RESIDENTIAL still above baseline and easing downward only slightly, persistent home-centered behavior should keep RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated or increases relative to the current week.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT stops recovering and falls back below its recent level, retail mobility will weaken within one week because mall and CBD shopping depend on public transport access. The signal is directional only when TRANSIT is still deeply suppressed and not breaking out of the current plateau.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by at least 2 points week-on-week after having improved for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: Reject if TRANSIT drops on the trigger condition but RETAIL_REC does not decline within the next week relative to its recent mean.

mechanism_narrative: A joint recovery in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM signals broader easing of caution and more multi-purpose trip chains. When outdoor leisure and essential errand mobility both strengthen together, shoppers are more likely to add retail stops, pushing RETAIL_REC up over four weeks.
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the next 28 days despite continued week-on-week gains in both PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS rises sharply while WORKPLACES remains weak, discretionary time is shifting outdoors rather than into shopping districts, which diverts nonessential trips away from retail. The effect should appear over two weeks because recreation choices reallocate the same travel budget quickly.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points from its recent week while WORKPLACES stays below -35
failure_condition: Reject if the trigger occurs and RETAIL_REC rises over the following 14 days instead of falling.

mechanism_narrative: A slow easing in RESIDENTIAL intensity combined with a continued narrowing of the gap between grocery and retail mobility means households are resuming bundled errands. That substitution should lift retail visits over the next four weeks because people combine shopping missions more often as outside time increases.
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC does not improve over 28 days while RESIDENTIAL declines and GROCERY_PHARM remains near its recent level or strengthens.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain deeply negative but stop worsening, retail mobility does not rebound immediately because the city is still operating under a constrained travel regime. The mechanism turns positive only after both series cross out of the current trough, so the next four weeks should still be weak if recovery stalls.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT each remain below -40 and change by less than 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay pinned below -40 without further improvement.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week surge in PARKS can act as an early warning for renewed discretionary movement that spills into retail visits shortly after. This is a fast signal: when park use accelerates from an already improving base, RETAIL_REC should follow within one week unless the rise is driven only by weather and not broader mobility recovery.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by at least 8 points week-on-week after two consecutive weeks of improvement
failure_condition: Reject if PARKS meets the trigger but RETAIL_REC does not increase within the next 7 days.
